brand_notes: Neumi (Neumitech): Amazon-centric budget brand; BS5 (6 ohm, 5in, front ports, ~$90-140 historically) and Silk 4 (rated 8 ohm, 4in, ~$190-200). Both measured by Erin with port-related midrange resonances, low sensitivity (82.2-82.5 dB vs 85-86 claimed) and impedance minima below IEC floor. Maker site links purchases to Amazon; BS5 first-party Amazon listing unavailable 2026-10-11. Sources: eac-neumi-bs5, eac-neumi-silk-4, mfr-neumi-bs5.
takeaways: Klippel LW deviation ±3.5 dB, f3 68 Hz, sensitivity 82.5 dB (claim 86 dB/1W at 6 ohm = ~87.3 dB at 2.83 V): ~4.8 dB below claim
Front-port radiation causes nulls near 800 Hz and 1.6 kHz; stuffing ports improves LW to ±2.3 dB and pref 4.6 but f3 90 Hz
Min impedance ~4.1 Ω (graph-read), below-iec; THD ~2.1% at 86 dB, ~3.2% at 96 dB (graph-read)
Max SPL ~93 dB @1 m with 80 Hz HPF, ~82 dB full range (EAC 2020 multitone)
Amazon tallies very positive on value; no outside critic reviews; availability/price uncertain (price left null)
conflicts: Sensitivity 82.5 (NFS) vs 84.2 (2020) vs claim 87.3 at 2.83 V
